question: In December 2024, the Commission initiated proceedings against TikTok under the Digital Services Act based on a suspected failure to properly analyse and address risks to electoral integrity. In October 2026, the Commission confirmed that it had received undisclosed information from the Romanian authorities. Almost two years later, the outcome of the proceedings has yet to be determined. Considering the above: 1.
What is the status of the investigation, and when does the Commission expect to complete these proceedings?

Is the Commission able to determine whether TikTok properly analysed and addressed the risks related to coordinated manipulation, recommender systems and paid political content, based on the information from the Romanian authorities?

Does the Commission plan to disclose the findings of this investigation, within the limits of confidentiality, and what measures will be taken to ensure that similar risks do not occur in future elections?
